name: Boost Note
description: The reviewed Boost Note main process uses electron-gh-releases against the BoostIO/boost-releases repository, checks periodically when packaged, downloads after confirmation, and installs after the download event. This snapshot does not substantiate the claimed verifyUpdateCodeSignature:false or a Boost Note-local SHA512 verification policy; dependency and released-artifact verification remain unresolved.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
The dependency's internal verification behavior and released update metadata/artifacts were not treated as primary application evidence.
No build or execution was performed.
